app.name: Voice Typer
app.firstLaunchHint: First launch can take 30–60 seconds while we download the speech model (~466 MB for small.en). Subsequent launches are much faster. You can close this window — dictation will work from the system tray once ready.
app.restartingHint: This usually takes a few seconds. Dictation will resume from the system tray once ready.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autostartDescription: Launch Voice Typer when you log in
settings.trayLeftClickDescription: What happens when you left-click the tray icon
settings.modelSizeDescription: Larger models are more accurate but slower
settings.silenceWarningDescription: Warn when no speech is detected for this many seconds
settings.autoStopDescription: Automatically stop recording after this duration
settings.bubblePositionDescription: Where the floating bubble appears on screen
settings.bubbleDraggableDescription: Allow dragging the bubble to reposition it
settings.bubbleShowOnStartupDescription: Show the bubble when the app starts (only when Always Visible)
settings.beamSizeDescription: Number of beams for beam search decoding
settings.conditionOnPreviousTextDescription: Use previous text as prompt for next segment
settings.volumeDuckSmartDescription: Only duck audio when speech is detected
settings.llmPolishDescription: Use AI to polish transcription output
settings.appLanguageDescription: Choose the interface language for Voice Typer.
settings.transcriptionLanguageDescription: Auto-detect the spoken language, or pick one for better accuracy.
settings.launchAtLoginDescription: Automatically start Voice Typer when you log into Windows.
settings.notificationsDescription: Show a desktop notification when transcription completes or an error occurs.
settings.trayClickDescription: What happens when you left-click the Voice Typer icon in the system tray.
settings.bubbleBehaviorInfo: Show the bubble only while recording, or keep it visible at all times.
settings.bubblePositionInfo: Where the bubble appears on screen — top or bottom center.
settings.showOnAppStartupInfo: Show the bubble as soon as the app opens. When off, it appears only when you start recording.
settings.dragToMoveInfo: Allow dragging the bubble with your mouse to reposition it on screen.
settings.autoPunctuationInfo: Add periods, commas, and question marks automatically.
settings.textCleanupInfo: Fix common misspellings, remove repeated words, and capitalize sentences.
settings.textSnippetsInfo: Use voice commands to insert pre-written text snippets with placeholders.
settings.vocabularyInfo: Custom word replacements so the transcription uses your preferred terms.
settings.enableInfo: Use an AI language model to clean up and improve the transcribed text. Requires an API key.
settings.apiKeyInfo: Your OpenAI-compatible API key for the polishing service.
settings.apiUrlInfo: The endpoint URL for the AI language model service.
settings.modelInfo: The AI model to use for polishing (e.g., gpt-4o-mini).
settings.presetInfo: The writing style to apply — professional, casual, email, or code.

tooltips.downloadModel: Download the selected speech recognition model

a11y.closeDialog: Press Esc or click outside to close.

help.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
help.cancel: Cancel recording, or close this dialog
help.closeHint: Press {key} or click outside to close.

history.title: History
history.clearAllMessage: Are you sure you want to clear all transcription history? Favorites will also be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
history.noResultsDescription: Try a different search term or clear the search to see all entries.
history.noFavoritesDescription: Tap the star icon on a transcription to save it here.
history.noTranscriptionsDescription: Press your hotkey (or Caps Lock) on the Home page to dictate — your transcriptions will appear here.
history.exportEmpty: Nothing to export — history is empty
